rules.text: Returns for online and store orders must take place within 45 days after the original shipment date in order to receive a credit in the original form of payment.
rules.quote: Returns for online and store orders must take place within 45 days after the original shipment date in order to receive a credit in the original form of payment.

rules.text: Returned/exchanged merchandise must be unworn and in new condition with the original tags and packaging including original hang-tags.
rules.quote: Returned/exchanged merchandise must be unworn and in new condition with the original tags. Returned/exchanged items must be returned in the original boxes and bags and must include all the original hang-tags.

rules.text: Refunds are issued to the original form of payment.
rules.quote: Returns for online and store orders must take place within 45 days after the original shipment date in order to receive a credit in the original form of payment.

rules.text: Original shipping fees will not be refunded unless the returned item was defective or you received a wrong item.
rules.quote: Original shipping fees will not be refunded unless the returned item was defective or you received a wrong item.

rules.text: Refund processing timeframe for Klarna payments is 3-7 business days to restore funds to your Klarna account.
rules.quote: The processing timeframe is **3-7 business days** to restore funds to your Klarna account.

rules.text: With a valid receipt, unworn merchandise is eligible for a full refund or exchange within 45 days of the original purchase date.
rules.quote: With a valid receipt, unworn merchandise is eligible for a full refund or exchange within 45 days of the original purchase date.

rules.text: With a valid receipt, unworn merchandise can be exchanged within 45 days of purchase.
rules.quote: With a valid receipt, unworn merchandise is eligible for a full refund or exchange within 45 days of the original purchase date.

rules.text: Without a receipt, unworn merchandise may be exchanged at the lowest selling price from the past 60 days with verification.
rules.quote: Without a receipt, unworn merchandise may be exchanged at the lowest selling price from the past 60 days, which may reflect any applicable promotions or discounts. Verification through a phone number and two-factor authentication is required.
rules.reviewNote: The summary omits that the lowest selling price may reflect promotions or discounts and does not mention the required verification through phone number and two-factor authentication, which are present in the quote.

rules.text: Returns received more than 45 days after shipment date will not be accepted and will be returned to sender.

rules.text: Items that do not meet the returns policy may be rejected.
